_comment: Suggested payload update for cron job dream-staging-nightly (169f92fa-1b75-4d28-9c43-d257bc42a7c8). Apply via: openclaw cron update <id> --patch '{"payload":{"message":"<new message below>"}}' OR via OpenClaw UI. Reference: REQUIREMENTS-dream-cycle-v2-rebuild.md FR-4.
name: dream-staging-nightly

payload.message:
Run the nightly dream cycle. Steps:

1. cd /home/erik-ross/.openclaw/workspace/projects/mesh-memory && node dream-cycle.mjs 2>&1 | tail -10
2. Check the resulting memory/dream-cycle-YYYY-MM-DD.md (YYYY-MM-DD is today's local date):
   - If the file starts with "# Dream Cycle — No Entries" → this is a no-entries run. Do NOT do steps 3 or 4. Do NOT send any Telegram message. Exit silently. (FR-4.1)
   - Otherwise continue to step 3.
3. Build a fact-tier staging file at memory/dream-staging/YYYY-MM-DD.md. Sources:
   - Today and yesterday daily logs from memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md
   - Mesh facts from http://127.0.0.1:18805/mesh/shared-pool (use curl; the v2-rebuild migration wired this up)
   - The dream-cycle output file from step 1
   Format: fact-tier only, provenance-tagged, with an unshared observations section and a contradictions section.
4. Commit the staging file: cd /home/erik-ross/.openclaw/workspace && git add memory/dream-staging/ && git commit -m "dream: staging file for YYYY-MM-DD"
5. Send a ONE-LINE confirmation to this chat (Telegram), e.g. "Dream staging 2026-07-24 done". (FR-4.2)
   If step 4 failed, send "Dream staging 2026-07-24 FAILED: <reason>". (FR-4.3)

Do NOT send any other message. Do not narrate intermediate steps.
